LastPass Emergency Access review: digital legacy verdict

Verdict: It works: contacts can request vault access after a wait period. LastPass's 2022 security breaches are a good reason to look at alternatives first, though.

Best for: Existing LastPass users who want to add emergency contacts without switching.

Pricing: Emergency Access is a paid-plan feature. Check current pricing.

Official site / docs ↗

Pros

  • Long-standing emergency access with a wait timer
  • Owner can decline a request during the wait period; otherwise access is granted automatically
  • Familiar to many families

Cons

  • Significant 2022 security incidents involving encrypted vault data
  • Feature availability depends on plan
  • Contacts need their own LastPass account

FAQ

What is LastPass Emergency Access best for?

Existing LastPass users who want to add emergency contacts without switching.

How much does LastPass Emergency Access cost?

Emergency Access is a paid-plan feature. Check current pricing.

Related

Vaults & password managers

Bitwarden

The best-value password manager with real emergency access: trusted contacts can request View or Takeover access after a wait time you set.

Vaults & password managers

1Password

Excellent password manager, but it has no automatic emergency-access feature. Legacy planning relies on the Emergency Kit and family account recovery.

Vaults & password managers

Keeper

A solid choice with built-in Emergency Access: name trusted contacts who can request your vault after a wait period.
